newsitem.title: USA: Engelhard/ICC gets $500,000 of Japanese orders.
newsitem.headline: Engelhard/ICC gets $500,000 of Japanese orders.

text.p: Engelhard/ICC said Monday it has received $500,000 in purchase orders for its active humidity control systems from its distribution partner in Japan, Nichimen Corp.
The units are to be shipped within the next several months, the ICC Technologies Inc Engelhard Corp joint venture said.

It said these purchases include repeat orders from a pachinko parlor company and an initial order from an 800-store Japanese supermarket chain, Miyagi Coop, located in the Sendai area on the northern coast of Japan.

"Our entry into the Japanese supermarket industry with Miyagi Corp is extremely significant, particularly as the company has the intention of making our desiccant units a standard specification for its new stores," Engelhard/ICC said.

"Based on our success in the U.S. supermarket industry, we believe that this market in Japan will be very important for us. We are also pleased to have repeat orders from the pachinko parlor industry. There are 18,000 pachinko (gambling) halls in Japan which suffer from poor air quality as a result of heavy smoking."

It also said "Nichimen and Yamaha (Motor Co Ltd ) -- the leading manufacturer of (natural) gas heat pumps in Japan -- are in the process of forming a partnership to jointly market the Yamaha Gas Heat Pump with our desiccant units as a joint product solution.
"Osaka Gas (Co Ltd ) is the second largest gas company in Japan and has found that the combination of our units with the Yamaha Gas Heat Pump creates a very competitive product," the venture said.

"Osaka Gas is now actively promoting our technology, and has installed our active humidity control systems in the high-profile Osaka Dome project. The Osaka Dome is a new multipurpose sports stadium currently under construction in Osaka, Japan."

It also said Tokyo Gas Co Ltd, the number one gas company in Japan which has played a leading role in developing the gas heat pump market, has approved the sale of Engelhard/ICC systems and will showcase its line of active humidity control units at its private trade fair to take place in Tokyo in June. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
